questions.q: What single question determines whether a Unity Catalog table is managed or external?
options: Whether Unity Catalog picks the storage path, or you specify one yourself
Whether the table has a primary key defined
Whether the table was created with Python or SQL
Whether the table is in the workspace catalog or a custom catalog
questions.explain: A managed table's storage path is chosen and controlled by Unity Catalog; an external table's path is one you specify, already registered as an external location.

questions.q: What happens to the underlying data files when a managed table is dropped?
options: Both the metadata and the underlying data files are deleted
Only the metadata is deleted; the files remain untouched
Nothing happens until an admin manually deletes the files
The files are automatically moved to an external location
questions.explain: Unity Catalog owns the full lifecycle of a managed table, so dropping it deletes both the catalog registration and the underlying data files.

questions.q: What happens to the underlying data files when an external table is dropped?
options: Only the catalog metadata/registration is removed; the files stay exactly where they were
The files are deleted along with the metadata, same as a managed table
The files are automatically converted into a managed table
Dropping an external table is not possible
questions.explain: Unity Catalog governs access to an external table's files but never owned their lifecycle, so dropping the table only removes the registration.

questions.q: Which SQL clause turns a CREATE TABLE statement into an external table?
options: LOCATION, pointing at a path registered as an external location
EXTERNAL = TRUE as a table property
USING EXTERNAL_STORAGE
There is no syntax difference between managed and external tables
questions.explain: Adding a LOCATION clause pointing at a registered external location path is what makes a CREATE TABLE statement produce an external table instead of a managed one.

questions.q: At which levels can a managed storage location be set, with the most specific one winning?
options: Metastore, catalog, and schema — schema being the most specific and overriding the others
Only at the metastore level; it cannot be overridden
Only at the individual table level
Only at the workspace level, never per catalog or schema
questions.explain: A managed storage location can be set at the metastore (account-wide default), catalog, or schema level, with the most specific level (schema) overriding the broader ones.
